# Awake Engine

> Awake Engine (AwakeKt) is a code-first Kotlin Multiplatform engine for interactive 2D and 3D apps and games. You write scenes, systems and UI in Kotlin; Awake renders with Vulkan (desktop, Android, iOS through MoltenVK) and WebGPU (web), simulates with Jolt physics, and ships a retained, Compose-shaped UI runtime. It is open source under the Apache License 2.0 and published to Maven Central. It is early alpha software: APIs and published modules can change between releases.

Awake Engine is the free, code-first core. Awake Studio is a separate visual editor built on it; the engine never depends on Studio.

## Docs

- [Installation](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/get-started/installation/): Gradle setup, Maven coordinates and versions for each target
- [Your first window](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/get-started/first-window/): the `app { }` entry point and the desktop host
- [Your first scene](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/get-started/first-scene/): entities, components and systems with the scene DSL
- [Load a scene document](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/get-started/load-a-scene-document/): load a `*.scene.json` document at runtime
- [Run in the browser](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/get-started/run-in-the-browser/): Kotlin/Wasm and WebGPU
- [ECS guide](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/guides/ecs/): the sparse-set entity component system
- [Scene documents](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/guides/scene-documents/): the scene file format and how scenes are saved and loaded
- [Physics](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/guides/physics/): rigid bodies, shapes and the Jolt backend
- [Game UI](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/guides/game-ui/): in-game UI built on the retained UI runtime
- [Vulkan backend](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/guides/vulkan/) and [WebGPU backend](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/guides/webgpu/): the rendering backends

## Reference

- [Modules](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/reference/modules/): every published module and what it is for
- [Scene document schema](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/reference/scene-document-schema/): the scene JSON schema
- [Component map](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/reference/component-map/): the ECS components the engine ships
- [Render hardware interface](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/reference/rhi/): the backend-neutral rendering contract
- [Releases and compatibility](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/reference/releases/): versions, platforms and compatibility
- [Glossary](https://docs.awakekt.com/latest/reference/glossary/)

## Samples

- [Live samples](https://demo.awakekt.com/): a WebGPU scene showcase and the Awake UI component gallery, running in the browser
- [Engine showcase source](https://github.com/awakekt/awake/tree/main/samples/engine-showcase): the complete working example

## Releases and packages

- [GitHub releases](https://github.com/awakekt/awake/releases): release notes for each version
- [Changelog](https://github.com/awakekt/awake/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)
- [Maven Central](https://central.sonatype.com/namespace/com.awakekt.awake.engine): artifacts are published under the group IDs `com.awakekt.awake.engine` (for example `bootstrap`), `com.awakekt.awake.asset` (for example `shaders`) and `com.awakekt.awake.backend` (`vulkan`)
- [Source repository](https://github.com/awakekt/awake): Kotlin sources, module guide and architecture notes

## Related: Awake Studio

- [Awake Studio](https://studio.awakekt.com/): the visual editor for Awake Engine, with 2D and 3D scene editing, game UI, node-based logic and shader graphs without code, and publishing games that play in the browser; a separate product with a free plan
- [Open in the browser](https://studio.awakekt.com/web/)
- [Download](https://studio.awakekt.com/download/)
- [User guide](https://studio.awakekt.com/docs/)
- [Pricing](https://studio.awakekt.com/pricing/)
